## analyzeGraph() function

Analyze a migration graph for connectivity, field profiles, and potential issues.

This performs a comprehensive analysis of the entire migration graph, checking for: - Version connectivity (can all versions reach each other?) - Field preservation patterns (which fields are preserved and how often?) - Potential issues (disconnected components, multi-value fields, etc.)

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare function analyzeGraph(graph: MigrationGraph, options?: AnalysisOptions): AnalysisResult;
```

## Example


```typescript
const graph = new MigrationGraph('semver');
graph.register({
  version: '1.0.0',
  schema: (data) => ({ success: true, data }),
});
graph.register({
  version: '2.0.0',
  schema: (data) => ({ success: true, data }),
});
graph.addMigration({
  fromVersion: '1.0.0',
  toVersion: '2.0.0',
  up: (data) => data,
  down: (data) => data,
});

const result = analyzeGraph(graph);
console.log(`Analyzed ${result.metadata.pathsAnalyzed} paths`);
console.log(`Found ${result.diagnostics.length} issues`);
```
